messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Agle mahine Bangalore wali trip hai, flight book karni hai ya train se jaana hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Flight dekh raha hoon but sach bataun to flying se bahut darr lagta hai mujhe.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sach? Kab se ye darr hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: 2019 mein ek flight mein itna turbulence aaya ki main poora kanpne laga, uske baad se.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Toh itne saal se kaise manage karta hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Window seat nahi leta, aur takeoff se pehle ek ghante tak kuch khata nahi hoon.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Kuch aur bhi karta hai ya bas yahi?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, ek breathing exercise hai jo maine YouTube pe seekhi thi, wahi kaam aati hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Train ka option kyun nahi soch raha phir?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Train se 22 ghante lagte hain, aur office se sirf teen din ki chhutti mili hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Ek baat bata, window seat chhodne ke alawa aisle comfortable lagta hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Aisle thoda better hai, par main middle seat book karta hoon taaki dono taraf log hon.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aur landing? Wo bhi tough hota hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Landing actually theek hai, mushkil sirf takeoff aur turbulence hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Chal, main ek flight tracker app bhej deti hoon, calm rehne mein help karegi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Thanks, aur haan mera ek goal bhi hai, is saal kam se kam do flight lena hai.

questions.answer_quote: flying se bahut darr lagta hai mujhe

questions.query: Rohan apni feelings ke baare mein khulkar likhta hai?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Kya hua, kal se thoda low lag raha hai tu?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Papa ki knee surgery ki date aa gayi, agle hafte Pune jaana hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Oh, knee replacement hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, left knee, doctor ne teen mahine physiotherapy bhi bola hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tu akela ja raha hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Mummy saath hain, main Thursday ki raat ki train lunga, Friday subah pahunch jaunga.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aur tu apni health ka dhyan rakh, tu bhi busy rehta hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Meri dikkat alag hai, mujhe lactose intolerance hai, doodh wali cheez se bachna padta hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Achha, aur gym chalu hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Gym do saal se band hai, but main chahta hoon November ke 10k run mein daudun.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Wo goal accha hai, roz subah daudta hai kya?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Roz nahi, sirf Sunday, kyunki Sunday ko main parents ko call karta hoon to subah free rehta hoon.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Call kitne baje hoti hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Hamesha saat baje subah, wo time humara fixed hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aur chai peeta hai itna, wo theek hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Raat ki chai chhod di, after 4 pm main kabhi chai nahi leta.

questions.query: Rohan ko lactose intolerance hai kya?
Ghar walon se baat karne ka koi fixed din hai?
Papa ka kaunsa ghutna operate hone wala hai?
Aditi ko lagta hai Rohan akela ja raha hai, usko kya jawab mila?
Parents se baat ka fixed samay kaunsa hai?
Kisne bataya ki wo November ke 10k run mein daudega?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aaj office mein sab theek tha?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Nahi, maine ek badi galti ki, client ka report galat bande ko bhej diya.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Arre, kitna bada issue bana?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Wo report mein client ke numbers the, par jo banda usko mila wo doosri team ka tha.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Toh tune kya kiya uske baad?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Maine turant apne manager ko bataya, aur us bande se mail delete karwa di.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Boss ne daant laga di?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Thoda suna diya, par usne kaha galti chhupane se bada hota hai, isliye batana theek tha.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tu aage se kaise bachega?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Ab main bhejne se pehle subject line do baar padhta hoon, ye mera naya rule hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Achha, aur kaam ka time?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Raat nau baje ke baad main kaam ka mail nahi kholta, wo meri limit hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aur wo guitar wala plan?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Guitar classes chalu hain, har Saturday, maine teen chord seekh liye.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Ek baat, tune pehle kaha tha tu cricket khelta tha?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Cricket chhoda tha 2021 mein, ab sirf weekend pe gully cricket khelta hoon.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sahi hai, tension mat le, galti sabse hoti hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, aur maine decide kiya hai ki July tak apni team ko ye process sikhaunga.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Kal raat tu online tha kaafi late, kya kar raha tha?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Ek bike ka page dekh raha tha, main Royal Enfield Himalayan lena chahta hoon.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Oh, kitna paisa lagega?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Around do lakh, isliye main har mahine pachas hazaar side mein rakhta hoon.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aur kitna time lagega?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Char mahine, agar kuch bada kharcha na aaye.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tu subah jaldi uthta hai, kaam ke liye?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Paanch baje pandrah minute pe alarm lagta hai, usse pehle main uth jaata hoon.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Itni jaldi kyun?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Subah ka time sabse calm hota hai, us waqt koi message nahi aata.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Aur wo crypto wali baat, kitna loss hua tha?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sattar hazaar udd gaye the 2024 mein, uske baad maine crypto chhod diya.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Ek baar bata, teri behen ka exam kaisa chal raha hai?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Behen Delhi mein hai, uski exam May mein hai, maine usko weekly notes bhejne shuru kiye.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Achha, aur swimming seekhne ka kya hua?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Deep water se bahut darr lagta hai, isliye maine classes chhod di.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Toh bike ka plan phir bhi chalega na?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, aur maine decide kiya hai ki bike lene ke baad Leh trip jaunga.
